# Width and Height of Elements

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Width and Height of Elements

Let's build on the previous example to see how block and inline elements handle width and height.

```html
1<p>This is a paragraph.</p>
2
3<span>This is a span</span>
```

```css
1p, span {
2    background: black;
3    color: white;
4
5    /* Add width and height properties */
6    width: 300px;
7    height: 100px;
8}
```

Browser Output

![Width and Height of Elements](data:image/png;base64,)

As you can see, the block-level element (<p>) takes the defined width and height. However, the width and height of the inline element (<span>) remain unchanged.

Block elements can be sized using width and height, while inline elements cannot without special handling.
